description: Issues the §3.1 claims with HS256 and the RFC 7515 A.1 key. The RFC's token has CRLFs, so the expected token was derived independently of polyjose: Python's hmac-SHA256 over BASE64URL('{"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}') . BASE64URL('{"iss":"joe","exp":1300819380,"http://example.com/is_root":true}'), the header (alg, then typ JWT, RFC 7519 §5.1) and claims (registered claims first, ADR 0027 §1) in compact JSON
